name: prod_jaundice_panc_head
findings:
There is a large hypodense irregular mass at the head of the pancreas measuring approximately 3 cm in size.
This is causing compression of the distal CBD with subsequent dilatation up to a maximum of 12 millimeters.
There is intra and extrahepatic biliary duct dilatation.

name: lung_nodule_silent
clinical_history: 68M, 40 pack-year smoker. Chronic cough and haemoptysis for 6 weeks. Referred for lung cancer workup. CT thorax with contrast for characterisation of nodule identified on recent chest X-ray.
findings: 22 mm spiculated nodule in the right upper lobe apical segment.

name: cerebellar_haem_silent
clinical_history:
onset at 13:30 with left facial droop, left arm and leg weakness and slurred speech.
BP 255/161
findings: - There is a large area of parenchymal hemorrhage in the right cerebellum measuring 5 cm in diameter

name: diverticulitis_silent
clinical_history: 66F, 4 days left iliac fossa pain, fever 38.2, WCC 15, CRP 180. Query diverticulitis.
findings:
- Sigmoid diverticulosis with segmental wall thickening over 6cm
- Pericolic fat stranding

name: pe_silent
clinical_history: 58M, sudden onset pleuritic chest pain and dyspnoea, SpO2 91% on air, HR 112, D-dimer 4.2, Wells score 6. Query PE.
findings: - Filling defects right main pulmonary artery extending into lower lobe segmental branches

name: mscc_silent
clinical_history: 72M metastatic prostate cancer, PSA 85. Three weeks progressive thoracic back pain, 48 hours bilateral leg weakness with two falls, new urinary hesitancy. Query cord compression.
findings: - Multilevel vertebral metastases at C7, T3, T7, T9, L2 and L4
